شعا (form I)
# شَعَّا (šaʕʕā) /ʃaʕ.ʕaː/: third-person masculine dual past active of شَعَّ (šaʕʕa)
# شُعَّا (šuʕʕā) /ʃuʕ.ʕaː/: third-person masculine dual past passive of شَعَّ (šaʕʕa)
# شِعَّا (šiʕʕā) /ʃiʕ.ʕaː/: second-person dual imperative of شَعَّ (šaʕʕa)
maddeler.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
